chunks: The Knower of the Absent and the Present, too exalted is He for what they associate (with Him)!
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah is the Knower of the Ghaib and the Shahadah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute sovereignty by contrasting His complete knowledge of the unseen and seen with the limited perception of polytheists. It serves as a theological foundation for Tawhid, emphasizing that divine transcendence (Tanzih) precludes any association of partners, a core tenet in understanding Allah's unique attributes.
